title: One person, three disciplines
sub: The story behind the commits — what I build, what I research, and how the engineering and the science feed each other.
bio: I'm an AI engineer, backend developer, and AI researcher who likes owning the whole stack — not just calling a model API, but the infrastructure that serves it, the model itself, and the evaluation that proves it works.

On the backend side I build production systems — APIs, data pipelines, and the reliability work that keeps them upright. On the AI side I work across ML, retrieval (RAG), and applied research, implementing ideas from first principles rather than treating models as black boxes. And as a researcher I turn those implementations into published work — reproducible, evaluated, and written up properly.
Currently open to opportunities where I can point all three at real problems.
motto: # build it, study it, ship it, write it up
